thesis: The episode discusses the launch of the Shop App, a consumer-facing brand for Shopify that merges the package tracker Arrive with Shop Pay to help users discover products, discounts, and local businesses. The conversation also explores the company's mission to increase the success rate of new businesses and its core value of being merchant-observed, framing consumer purchasing decisions as a form of voting for the businesses they support.
